[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 63[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to the Hack Forum News. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6331108][color=#ffffff]New BTCpay Server[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

A brand new BTCPay Server is currently being set up as part of Hack Forums move. The server has already been rented and configured and the blocks for BTC and LTC are now syncing. XMR will also be added to once the initial sync finishes. By migrating this saves $10 a month but more importantly provides much greater control and reliability on the new VPS. It may take a week or so to get everything fully online. Feel free to reach out if you have any questions in the meantime. Thank you.

[u][b][size=large]Attendance Records Shattered[/size][/b][/u]

Gamescom the world's largest in person gaming event in Cologne Germany officially wrapped up with record breaking attendance numbers surpassing last year's 350,000 visitors.

[u][b][size=large]Massive Steam Data Leak[/size][/b][/u]

Over 12 terabytes of pre release game builds spanning a 10 year period were exposed and entered public circulation from Valve's depository.

[u][b][size=large]Release Window[/size][/b][/u]

A senior official from Rockstar North reassured fans that the game is firmly on course for its November 2026 launch following prior internal delays.

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/ves-brown.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=5458992]

[color=#C10300][b][size=15]Caring Matters[/size][/b][/color]

In a world where everyone seems to be busy with their own problems, caring about someone else can mean more than we realize.

Sometimes caring isn't about doing something big. It's checking on a friend, listening when someone needs to talk, offering help without being asked, or simply letting someone know that they aren't alone.

We often underestimate the impact of small acts of kindness. A simple message at the right moment can brighten someone's entire day. A few minutes of your time can remind someone that they matter.

And caring doesn't make you weak. It means you understand that people are more important than pride, arguments, or temporary problems.

You may never know how much your kindness meant to someone—but that doesn't make it any less valuable.

[hr]

[color=#FF851B][size=15]Advice of the week[/size][/color]

Care about people while you still have the chance. Sometimes the smallest gesture becomes someone's biggest memory.

[hr]

[color=#008E02][size=15]Quote of the week[/size][/color]

“No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted.”
— Aesop
